exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (grouped as 3 or less, or 4 or more)
cohort: 100 pregnant females undergoing elective or emergency cesarean sections, all with at least one previous cesarean section.
finding: Higher order cesarean sections (4 or more) are associated with a significantly increased risk of maternal complications including dense adhesions, placenta previa, and bladder injury compared to lower order cesarean sections (3 or less).
mod_finding: The risk of maternal complications significantly increases with higher order (4 or more) cesarean sections compared to lower order (3 or less) cesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Data collected from July to December 2017
